_meta.purpose: Budget asks priced for the current reporting month. Every ask carries a price, a basis and a success measure (CLAUDE_CODE_BUILD_PROMPT.md: 'every recommendation carries a price and a success measure'). Paid-media asks are priced all-in: media plus the 20% agency surcharge the approved budget derives on Google + Meta spend (src.data.spend.price_ask).
_meta.source: Carried from the v1 Marketing Activity page (Aug 2026 deck): '$1K retargeting ask ... $3,000 for the 90-day retargeting run' and '$1,750 for a second focus group'. Re-priced here for September-December and with the agency surcharge v1 omitted.

asks.label: Google new-customer retargeting, September to December
asks.basis: Follow each new customer for ninety days from the first purchase, aimed at the second order. Most eventual second orders happen inside that window.
asks.success_measure: Median days to a second order falls below the current figure, and the reorder rate on small first orders (under four hundred dollars) rises above its current level, measured in NetSuite on September-onward cohorts against the pre-campaign baseline.

asks.label: Second customer focus group
asks.basis: The only instrument that answers why two-thirds of a cohort never reorders. Retargeting treats the symptom; research finds the cause.
asks.success_measure: A written set of reorder blockers ranked by frequency, delivered before the fourth-quarter planning cycle.
